related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment focused ECI and projection CLI tests

request.correction_note: The earlier record used Git blob object IDs as SHA-256 source digests. These pointers now contain actual SHA-256 content digests.

verified_behaviors: bounded unclassified capability-call groups retain exact event references
binding identity and completion context/outcome are represented without agent attribution
compact response-budget behavior retains activity evidence within configured limits
service-accountability digest changes with nested probe activity
outcome.interpretation_limit: The tests establish projection representation and size bounds. The live readback exposes authentic call references, but neither establishes service need, fulfillment, agent receipt, or reduced intervention burden.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Session evidence records ambient capability calls without the scheduler decisions that explain them
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose bounded scheduled and skipped owner-pass decisions with measured pass duration in the entry response and the existing session activity projection, without adding a write for a quiet run.

not_measured: whether independent agents discover or use the projection
whether this environmental change reduces intervention burden
whether future events contain complete scheduler context
whether service opportunity and agent need are recorded
